judge.rationale: The core `ToolRegistry` implementation with `ajv` schema compilation, WeakMap caching for dynamic definitions, and error formatting without value leakage is solid and functional. However, the candidate stopped partway through its own Definition of Done, leaving `.lore/dod.md` committed in the tree and omitting all requested updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`. Several required unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` (extra property passthrough, dynamic schema changes per call, static compilation once across 10 calls, and unknown tool throw) and `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` were either omitted or placed in an unrequested `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file. Finally, the `CHANGELOG.md` entry only mentions `register` throwing on invalid schemas while completely omitting the main `execute` validation behavior and migration note.
